title: 36 Hours in San Juan, Puerto Rico
abstract: In this pastel-hued capital city, you can sample cocktails and culture, shopping and surf, all in a single weekend.

title: 36 Hours in Melbourne, Australia
abstract: Home to street art, buzzing cafes and a cool bar scene, Australia’s second city is charged with creative energy.

title: 36 Hours in Davos, Switzerland
abstract: From skiing to solariums, art to fondue, you can find it in this sky-high Swiss city in the Alps.

title: 36 Hours in Panama City Beach, Fla.
abstract: Peer beyond the tattoo parlors and sweaty spring breakers and you’ll find everything from sugary sands to a farmers’ market in this Emerald Coast town.
